result.summary: Found 1 minor visual issue: the promotional banner text is too low-contrast against its pale green background, making it look washed out and harder to read.

issues.description: The promo card copy ('3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext) has very low contrast on the light green background.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast by using a darker text color or slightly darkening the banner background so the message is clearly readable.
